verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order (logo, headline, copy, CTA at the bottom) and the sky/sunglasses scene, but its logo is blown up and straddles the panel's top edge with white on pale sky (poor contrast), the badge is squashed into a flat tilted sliver stuck in the bottom-left, and the panel runs nearly to the right edge.
